CHARLES WIDGER SCHOOL OF LAW

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for admission to the JD program, an applicant must have successfully completed a baccalaureate program and taken the Law School Admissions Test (LSAT).

JD Application Checklist - detailed instructions can be found in the online application portal

  • Personal Statement - please address the prompt in the application instructions, 11-point font or larger, double space, maximum 3 pages
  • Resume

The essay is part of the online application. Have questions? Contact us?
